text: Two notes only: status comment on the idea, hypothesis + reflection on the connection
description: Felix 2026-10-16: a reflection only makes sense as the test of a hypothesis, and the hypothesis lives on the parent→child connection. Decided: an idea keeps one free-text note, status.comment (why it is in this state). Each connection keeps hypothesis (why the child should help the parent) and reflection (free text: how that turned out). Data model 5 migration: fold idea.reflection and idea.reflections[] (context/outcome/effectiveness/lesson/pattern) into status.comment; rename connection evaluation back to reflection (and meta.json promptsEvaluation → promptsReflection); drop ReflectionSchema, the addReflection tool/endpoint, and the reflection textarea in the edit modal.

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Reflections only teach when the hypothesis could have failed; filtering out classifications raises the share of edges that actually get tested.
supportingConnections.reflection: First half held: ~70% of existing hypotheses (170 of 241) could never fail, so there was nothing to reflect on. Second half (the share of tested edges rises) is not observed yet; the guidance only took effect 2026-11-01.

status.comment: Data model 5 migration (v5-two-notes) folds idea.reflection and reflections[] into status.comment, renames connection evaluation → reflection and promptsEvaluation → promptsReflection; addReflection tool/endpoint and the edit-modal reflection textarea removed (status comment is now a multi-line textarea); /dream keeps its memory in one dream-memory idea's status comment. pnpm check 25/25; verify:migration on this repo: graph unchanged, no conflicts, second run no-op; live .bowman migrated 4 → 5. Awaiting Felix's acceptance.
